create_combined_transport_model: create a CombinedTransportModel that combines core and pedestal transport model coefficients
build_runtime_params: build RuntimeParams with sequences of transport model and pedestal transport model parameters
run_combined_model: run CombinedTransportModel to compute turbulent transport coefficients from core and pedestal models
combine_transport_coefficients: combine transport coefficients from multiple models using ADD or OVERWRITE merge modes
calculate_pedestal_domain_mask: calculate the active domain mask for pedestal transport models based on rho_norm_ped_top
